data.description: Found by the PQ-47 delegator on 2026-11-03, after PQ-62 (PR #125) merged. distribution_lint in pipeline/src/popquiz/audit.py walks the working tree, so in a delegator worktree it reads the untracked .claude/ files (checkpoint-*.md, boot-prompt.md) and flags the test counts written in them as distribution tells. CI is unaffected (those files are never committed), but a local just test in a worktree can fail. Fix: add .claude to DISTRIBUTION_SKIP_DIRS (audit.py:899) or walk only git-tracked files; decide which with the client. Acceptance: a planted .claude/checkpoint.md containing a percentage in a temp repo is not reported, a test fails without the fix, real-tree scan still 0 hits / 0 unreadable, just test green. Touch only audit.py and test_audit.py.
